_comment: The role table (SYSTEM 8-2). Users, groups, channels, credentials, sudoers,
sshd, egress and the access checks are all generated from this file by
roles.py. Whatever is written here is checked; whatever is not is refused.
model     who does the judging: claude, local, or null (no model at all)
invoked   true: runner may start it, through /srv/loop/bin/<role>-run only
tools     claude roles: the only tools the CLI is started with
work      read: may read the workspaces under /srv/loop/work. Nobody but
runner writes there -- every role writes to its own out/ only,
and the window copies what passes into the workspace
login     ssh-window: may log in over SSH, into loop-window and nothing else
code      claude roles: true -- may hand code to calc through code-mcp (the run
claude_model  claude roles: the model the launcher starts it with
calc      the one role code-mcp may run code as: no network, no workspace,
started by the roles with code, never by runner
